name: Custom
description: Blank declaration. Use this for an API that matches none of the presets — an ERP, an internal service, a vendor API.
notes: Start from the closest preset instead if one is even roughly similar — the Test panel makes correcting it faster than writing from scratch.
Decide filterStyle first: does the API take one query param per filter (mode `params`), or merge them into a single expression param (mode `composed`)?
Then pagination: how a page is requested (query params vs a Range header), and where the total comes back (response body path, response header, or not at all).
Finally, per operation, decide how the API signals 'no such record' — and make sure it is distinguishable from a wrong URL. See spec §9.1; a filtered list endpoint is usually the safer shape.
